name: Slit-scan datamosh
doc: Temporal slit-scan ribbon over the input media using feedback history, warped by its edge field with beat-synced slit jumps, RGB channel tears, and macroblock corruption on onsets.

edges.doc: luma gradient field (e.g. core-media.edges) for edge-aligned scanline warp

luma.doc: perceptual brightness mask (e.g. core-media.luma) for live subject punch-through

palette.doc: accent tint for glitch tears and slit-line highlight

axis.doc: direction of the rolling slit-scan ribbon

drift.doc: how fast the slit-scan history scrolls across the frame

slit.doc: width of the live capture slit

live_mix.doc: how strongly the live subject punches through the slit-scan history

edge_warp.doc: displacement of history along the media edge field

rgb.doc: RGB chromatic split on onsets and edges

tear.doc: macroblock and scanline tear intensity on beats and onsets

decay.doc: persistence of the slit-scan ribbon trail
